plain: Under data-accent="cobalt" the secondary Button hover is now grey (surface.softHover), not navy; nothing to change unless a screenshot test pins the old hover.

steps.plain: Under data-accent="cobalt", --component-button-secondary-bg-hover now resolves to the grey surface.softHover instead of the navy surface.accentSubtle; if your CSS relied on the navy hover, set the variable yourself.
